sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_alter_parent (bucket integer, raw text, qty integer) PARTITION BY LIST (bucket);
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_alter_child PARTITION OF type_matrix_alter_parent FOR VALUES IN (1);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_alter_raw_idx ON type_matrix_alter_parent (raw);
INSERT INTO type_matrix_alter_child (bucket, raw, qty) VALUES (1, '12', 3), (1, 'bad', 4);
ALTER TABLE type_matrix_alter_parent ALTER COLUMN raw TYPE integer;
SELECT raw, pg_typeof(raw)::text FROM type_matrix_alter_child ORDER BY qty;
ALTER TABLE type_matrix_alter_parent ALTER COLUMN raw TYPE integer USING raw::integer;
SELECT raw, pg_typeof(raw)::text FROM type_matrix_alter_child ORDER BY qty;
UPDATE type_matrix_alter_child SET raw = '13' WHERE raw = 'bad';
ALTER TABLE type_matrix_alter_parent ALTER COLUMN raw TYPE integer USING raw::integer + qty;
SELECT bucket, raw, qty, pg_typeof(raw)::text FROM type_matrix_alter_child ORDER BY qty;

SELECT c.relname::text, format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid WHERE c.relname IN ('type_matrix_alter_parent', 'type_matrix_alter_child') AND a.attname = 'raw' ORDER BY c.relname;
SELECT c.relname::text, i.indclass::text FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = i.indexrelid WHERE c.relname = 'type_matrix_alter_raw_idx';
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE type_matrix_alter_parent ALTER COLUMN raw TYPE bigint;
SELECT format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid WHERE c.relname = 'type_matrix_alter_parent' AND a.attname = 'raw';
ROLLBACK;
SELECT format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid WHERE c.relname = 'type_matrix_alter_parent' AND a.attname = 'raw';
ALTER TABLE type_matrix_alter_parent ALTER COLUMN bucket TYPE bigint;
ALTER TABLE type_matrix_alter_child ALTER COLUMN raw TYPE bigint;
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_alter_unique (value text UNIQUE);
INSERT INTO type_matrix_alter_unique VALUES ('01'), ('1');
ALTER TABLE type_matrix_alter_unique ALTER COLUMN value TYPE integer USING value::integer;
SELECT value, pg_typeof(value)::text FROM type_matrix_alter_unique ORDER BY value;
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_alter_default (value varchar(8) DEFAULT 'abc');
ALTER TABLE type_matrix_alter_default ALTER COLUMN value TYPE integer USING length(value);
SELECT format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid WHERE c.relname = 'type_matrix_alter_default' AND a.attname = 'value';
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_alter_fk_parent (id text PRIMARY KEY);
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_alter_fk_child (parent_id text REFERENCES type_matrix_alter_fk_parent(id));
INSERT INTO type_matrix_alter_fk_parent VALUES ('1');
INSERT INTO type_matrix_alter_fk_child VALUES ('1');
ALTER TABLE type_matrix_alter_fk_parent ALTER COLUMN id TYPE varchar USING id || 'x';
SELECT id, pg_typeof(id)::text FROM type_matrix_alter_fk_parent;
ALTER TABLE type_matrix_alter_fk_parent ALTER COLUMN id TYPE integer USING id::integer;
SELECT format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid WHERE c.relname = 'type_matrix_alter_fk_parent' AND a.attname = 'id';
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_alter_generated (id integer PRIMARY KEY, qty integer, doubled integer GENERATED ALWAYS AS (qty * 2) STORED);
INSERT INTO type_matrix_alter_generated (id, qty) VALUES (1, 3);
UPDATE type_matrix_alter_generated SET qty = 4 WHERE id = 1;
SELECT qty, doubled FROM type_matrix_alter_generated;
INSERT INTO type_matrix_alter_generated (id, qty) VALUES (1, 6) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET qty = excluded.qty, doubled = DEFAULT;
SELECT qty, doubled FROM type_matrix_alter_generated;
UPDATE type_matrix_alter_generated SET doubled = 99 WHERE id = 1;
SELECT is_generated, generation_expression IS NOT NULL AS has_expression FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'type_matrix_alter_generated' AND column_name = 'doubled';
ALTER TABLE type_matrix_alter_generated ALTER COLUMN qty TYPE bigint;
CREATE TYPE type_matrix_alter_state AS ENUM ('open', 'closed');
CREATE DOMAIN type_matrix_alter_positive AS integer CHECK (VALUE > 0);
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_alter_user_types (state text, amount integer);
INSERT INTO type_matrix_alter_user_types VALUES ('open', 2);
ALTER TABLE type_matrix_alter_user_types ALTER COLUMN state TYPE type_matrix_alter_state USING state::type_matrix_alter_state;
ALTER TABLE type_matrix_alter_user_types ALTER COLUMN amount TYPE type_matrix_alter_positive;
SELECT state::text, amount::text, pg_typeof(state)::text, pg_typeof(amount)::text FROM type_matrix_alter_user_types;
CREATE VIEW type_matrix_alter_view AS SELECT raw FROM type_matrix_alter_parent;
ALTER TABLE type_matrix_alter_parent ALTER COLUMN raw TYPE bigint;
